# T-2: Repair managed Git cache

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Return dirty .senti/plugin-sources Git URL caches to a managed target state before adopting a commit.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Dirty managed cache is reset/cleaned to the resolved target commit.
- Unrecoverable managed cache is deleted and recloned.
- File mode only dirty state does not cause stale HEAD adoption.
- Local path dirty source rejection remains unchanged.
- Reset/clean/delete/reclone runs only after verifying the cache path is under .senti/plugin-sources/ for the current root.

## Implementation Notes
Limit destructive reset/clean/reclone behavior to checkedOutSourceRoot() for Git URL sources under pluginSourcesDir(root). Normalize and verify the resolved path before destructive operations; reject unsafe source ids or paths. Use bounded fallback and surface command failures with masked source details.

## Test Strategy
Spec-local tests dirty the managed cache with content and file mode changes; shared regression keeps local path dirty rejection.
